title: PNP steps up security as post-Undas travel rush begins
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) maintained heightened security at major transport terminals and key roads as millions of Filipinos began returning home following the Undas…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) maintained heightened security at major transport terminals and key roads as millions of Filipinos began returning home following the Undas holidays. “As travelers make their way back to their homes, schools, and workplaces, the PNP remains fully mobilized to keep roads secure, maintain public order, and respond swiftly to any incident that may disrupt travel,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. in a statement on Monday. “Our priority is to ensure that every Filipino reaches their destination safely,” Nartatez added.
